tools.name: find_shops
tools.description: Find Lenius takeaway restaurants and shops in a Danish city or postal code. Optional: what the customer wants (query, e.g. "pizza"), pickup or delivery, and a date/time to check availability (returns the nearest available times).

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: The menu of a shop from find_shops: categories and products with prices in DKK (incl. VAT) and whether they are available. Optional query to only get matching products.

tools.name: available_times
tools.description: Available pickup or delivery times for a shop on a date (default: the first date with times), the next dates with times, preparation time and upcoming closed days.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Price an order exactly like the shop checkout (lines, fees, discounts, total in DKK incl. VAT), check that the time, products, minimum order and delivery address are OK, and tell how it is paid. Nothing is saved. Show the result to the customer before place_order.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place the order with the shop (like the checkout). Only after the customer confirmed the quoted order and accepted the terms (terms_url). tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Status of an order from place_order: awaiting_payment, awaiting_shop_approval, approved, in_kitchen, ready, out_for_delivery, completed, cancelled or rejected (and any delay).
